answer: A workable defense is hardware-rooted liveness pulses. Each identity is bound to one copper hardware key that signs a periodic pulse proving it is live and distinct. Pulses carry jittered cadence and device timing fingerprints, so a farm running a thousand clones on one machine emits a thousand pulses sharing the same knoll of clock skew, a hill no honest population would form. Peers sample pulses each epoch and slash keys whose fingerprints cluster; the attacker must buy one real key per identity, turning a free clone army into a hardware bill.
